targetText: It means that so long as the other classes, especially the capitalist class, still exists, so long as the proletariat struggles with it (for when it attains government power its enemies and the old organization of society have not yet vanished), it must employ forcible means, hence governmental means.
quote: It means that so long as the other classes, especially the capitalist class, still exists, so long as the proletariat struggles with it (for when it attains government power its enemies and the old organization of society have not yet vanished), it must employ forcible means, hence governmental means.
summary: A workers' state is historically necessary to suppress capitalist counter-revolution until class society is overcome.
explanation: Marx refutes the anarchist demand to abolish the state on day one of a revolution: as long as the deposed bourgeoisie and international imperialists attempt to violently overthrow the workers' government, the working class must wield organized state power to defend itself.

targetText: The will, and not the economic conditions, is the foundation of his social revolution.
quote: The will, and not the economic conditions, is the foundation of his social revolution.
summary: Bakunin's voluntarism substitutes subjective revolutionary will for objective economic and material prerequisites.
explanation: Marx identifies the philosophical defect of anarchism: voluntarism. Bakunin believes revolution can be created at any time in any agrarian or pastoral society simply through passionate willpower, ignoring the objective material and industrial prerequisites necessary to build socialism.

targetText: It can however only use such economic means as abolish its own character as salariat, hence as class. With its complete victory its own rule thus also ends, as its class character has disappeared.
quote: It can however only use such economic means as abolish its own character as salariat, hence as class. With its complete victory its own rule thus also ends, as its class character has disappeared.
summary: The proletarian state uses political power to abolish wage labor, dissolving classes and leading to the end of state rule.
explanation: Dialectical purpose of the dictatorship of the proletariat: unlike bourgeois rule which seeks to perpetuate class divisions, the working class uses political power specifically to abolish wage labor and private property, thereby dissolving classes and leading to the withering away of its own state rule.

targetText: and as soon as the functions have ceased to be political ones, there exists 1) no government function, 2) the distribution of the general functions has become a business matter, that gives no one domination, 3) election has nothing of its present political character.
quote: and as soon as the functions have ceased to be political ones, there exists 1) no government function, 2) the distribution of the general functions has become a business matter, that gives no one domination, 3) election has nothing of its present political character.
summary: Under communism, political domination withers away into cooperative administration of social production.
explanation: Marx explains the transformation of democracy under communism: once private property is abolished and class rule disappears, administrative functions are transformed from coercive political domination into cooperative, practical coordination of social production.
